title: SM-09.18 - Rules for Email Report recipients
intent: This article answers: SM-09.18 - Rules for Email Report recipients
short_answer: Email Report recipients must be entered as valid email addresses. EUSurvey validates the format and checks that the domain is not on a known blacklist. A maximum of 10 email addresses is allowed.
important_conditions: Separate multiple email addresses with a semicolon.
Each email appears on a separate line after it is added.
Remove an email address by clicking the cross next to it.
The input field has a 255-character limit.
If an email address is invalid, an error message is shown.
